message.content:
I asked you to modify the file `multiagent_router_pro.py` according to a technical specification from an architect. The task was to add the `/evolve` command behavior that prints the current system time to stdout immediately when the script starts, before any routing begins.

You added `import datetime` to the imports block right after `import logging`, and modified the `if __name__ == "__main__":` block at the end of the file to fetch the current time using `datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")` and print it with a `print()` call before the `main()` function is invoked. The output format is `Скрипт запущен: 2023-10-25 14:30:00`.

The changes were limited to the initialization layer only — no modifications to routing logic, agent operations, or file logging. You used only the built-in `datetime` module as required, avoiding `time.ctime()` and any third-party libraries. The existing functionality including memory loading, routing rules, and the `AgentOrchestrator` class remains intact.
